subject: PO token mismatch after vendor form resubmission — spend cap placed
messages:

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor form resubmission — PO token mismatch and spend cap

Hi David / Monica,

We just resubmitted our vendor intake form (attached) after the finance team requested tax ID verification. After the form went in, our account in your portal jumped into a provisional state and shows a different PO token (PN-98342 vs PN-98307) on the ledger. Our procurement workflow depends on PN-98307 being present for the current invoice run.

Can you confirm whether PN-98342 is a duplicate provisional token or a replacement? We're on a tight timeline for this month-end billing. Also seeing a temporary spend cap of $15k applied to our account — was that auto-applied because of the resubmission?

Attachments: intellivend-onboard-v2.pdf (vendor intake form), vendor-forms-receipt.txt (attachment stub)

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Procurement Lead, IntelliVend
procurement@intellivend.com

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: IntelliVend Procurement <procurement@intellivend.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form resubmission — PO token mismatch and spend cap

Hi Alex — thanks for flagging this.

Quick update after a first-pass check: the intake form appeared to trigger an automated provisional token issuance because the tax-id change created a new supplier fingerprint. That generated PN-98342 as a provisional placeholder while our onboarding pipeline re-hashes the ledger. PN-98307 is still linked to the original intake but the system should have reconciled; it looks like a race left both active.

Immediate actions I'm taking:
- Putting a manual hold on the provisional token PN-98342 so invoices won't route against it while we reconcile.
- Looping in our procurement activation lead (Monica) to run the ledger merge and collapse duplicate tokens into PN-98307 if appropriate.
- Sharing the intake PDF with our onboarding QA team and attaching the current mapping CSV for review.

Can you confirm whether any invoices were already submitted against PN-98342? If so, include invoice IDs. If not, we can keep PN-98342 in a provisional state until the merge completes.

I'll follow up with a status update by EOD.

Best,
David Kim
Vendor Onboarding Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: po-mapping-csv.csv (generated mapping from ledger)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, IntelliVend Procurement <procurement@intellivend.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T12:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form resubmission — PO token mismatch and spend cap

Thanks David. Alex — quick note from procurement activation:

Summary of what we see: the new intake created a secondary supplier fingerprint because the "billing address" field was normalized slightly differently (suite vs #). That triggered PN-98342 as provisional. PN-98307 remains the primary token with all historical allocations.

Proposed remediation (30–60 minute window):
- Run a ledger merge that will:
  • Remap any provisional lines on PN-98342 to PN-98307, preserving original line-item IDs.
  • Re-evaluate spend caps: current system applied $15,000 as a provisional cap for new tokens; we'll roll that configuration back for merged tokens so IntelliVend sees the original $250k cap.

Ask for you (Alex): can you confirm there are no live purchase orders currently in "processing" state against PN-98342? If there are, list the PO numbers so we can do a safe reorder and avoid double-applying charges.

I'll schedule the merge after we get Alex's confirmation and will provide a rollback plan in case we need to revert.

—Monica
Sr. Procurement Activation Manager, Redwood Inference
Monica Patel

On merges: we'll keep the prov token in a tombstone state for traceability after merge.

From: Alex Johnson <procurement@intellivend.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form resubmission — PO token mismatch and spend cap

Thanks Monica — quick check with our billing team:

- No invoices processed against PN-98342 yet.
- There is one pending PO (IV-2026-1104) that was created after the form resubmission but hasn't routed for payment.

We are comfortable with the merge as long as IV-2026-1104 carries over to PN-98307 and the spend cap is restored. Please proceed and confirm once complete.

Attachments: capture-IV-2026-1104.png (screenshot stub)

Appreciate the quick response — our month-end closes in two business days.

Alex

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, IntelliVend Procurement <procurement@intellivend.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor form resubmission — PO token mismatch and spend cap

All — merge completed at 15:30 PST. Notes:

- PN-98342 provisional lines were remapped to PN-98307. Line item IDs preserved; we added audit tags: "merged_from=PN-98342", "merge_job=MJ-4472".
- Spend cap reverted: IntelliVend now has the original $250,000 cap in the system.
- PO IV-2026-1104 was moved to PN-98307 and queued for normal routing.
- We left a tombstone entry for PN-98342 for traceability.

Attachments: merge-log-MJ-4472.txt (attachment stub).

Alex — please verify invoices/PO visibility on your side and reply to confirm closure; we'll close the provisional ticket after 48 hours of no issues.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Platform Reliability — Redwood Inference

On case closure: if any downstream accounting reconciliation is needed, reply with the list of affected invoice IDs and we'll run a targeted ledger dump for export.
